snippet.title: Longplay of Jurassic Park: Operation Genesis
snippet.description:
Longplay of Jurassic Park: Operation Genesis, played with the NTSC version on the PlayStation 2. This game's version was released on Mar. 25th, 2003. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

0:00:00 - Intro
0:04:38 - 0 star park (Building foundations, negative budget and dinosaur gazing (No twister))
0:42:15 - 1 Star park (Chad Storm, new dinosaurs and start of diseases (Noo twister yet still))
1:19:52 - 2 Star park (Dinosaur gazing and cleaner army(Havent seen a breeze in a while, must be lucky))
1:46:50 - 3 Stars park (The Gallimimus that killed raptors, tree planting and a very short jeep ride (Still no wind in sight))
2:38:10 - 4 Stars park (Cows galore, T-rexes and mass diseases (I am lucky))
4:13:53 - 5 Stars park (Releasing the dinosaurs)
4:41:47 - Missions to unlock site B
5:45:16 - Dinopedia
5:59:16 - Site B

By: iamalamb
